cues: Do not mix up the two sheaths.
The myelin sheath is the fatty insulation made by the Schwann cell.
The neurilemma is the Schwann cell's own thin outer membrane, outside the myelin.
Non myelinated fibres still have a neurilemma; they just have no myelin and no nodes.
